title: vidtoolz.resolveProductionReadAuthority.v1
description: Human-governed source record authorizing the nine read-only Resolve operations against ONE local Disk Project Library on vidnux, read through an isolated Resolve session whose provenance the worker attests. v1 is structurally vidnux-only and Linux-only: PRESTO, VIDLAP2, Windows, UNC roots and network libraries (EKA, nelja, PostgreSQL/QPSQL) are not authorizable by this schema at all. Compiled deterministically into vidtoolz.resolveProductionReadRuntimePolicy.v1 by tools/compile_production_read_policy.py, which enforces this schema natively (closed objects, exact enums/patterns, real calendar dates) before anything else. A LIVE policy is produced ONLY from status ACCEPTED with an allowlisted human approver, a real approval date, an acceptance-record reference, the exact worker byte pin and the accepted facade commit; every other record compiles only with --preview into a non-live deny-all artifact the worker refuses to serve. An unaccepted record MAY leave library null and projects empty while awaiting the human scope selection; an ACCEPTED record MUST name exactly one library and at least one project UUID. Deny by default; no wildcards.

approved_by.description: null until a human accepts; otherwise the allowlisted approver recorded by repository convention

approved_at.description: real calendar date (the compiler parses it; 2026-02-30 is refused)

acceptance_record.description: path of the governance acceptance record that carries the human decision

worker_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact production-read worker file this grant is for; the worker re-hashes its own bytes at every operation and compares

commit.description: accepted Hermes facade commit; the worker refuses a policy naming any other facade

session_profile_type.description: the only supported read model: a freshly launched, isolated Resolve session whose profile registers exactly the authorized Disk library

name.description: library display name; must not be a prohibited library (Local Database, EKA*, nelja*)

canonical_root.description: canonical physical root: an absolute local path equal to its own realpath. The isolated profile registers exactly this root and the worker re-resolves it at every operation.

physical_dev.description: st_dev of the physical root; mandatory (textual identity alone is never sufficient)

physical_ino.description: st_ino of the physical root; mandatory

projects.description: explicit project UUIDs; empty NEVER means all. Empty is permitted only while the record is unaccepted.

project_open_law.const: read the project the human already opened; never LoadProject/OpenProject/SetCurrentProject/SetCurrentDatabase

network_libraries.const: DEFERRED — not authorized by v1 (EKA, nelja)

execution_environment.description: the only authorizable execution environment. The isolated-session-only model of the 0.4.0 candidate carried a launch-time profile-rollback defect that the capsule closes, and is no longer authorizable.

host_primitive.description: the APPROVED dedicated-capsule host boundary, verbatim. Independent host review approved it on 2026-09-22 (review manifest 84f5bcbc…, 31/31 verified). It is not descriptive: the worker re-derives every field from the running system before a production read is served, and again at every operation.

capsule_account.description: the dedicated account the worker and Resolve run as; the operator cannot enter it

broker_path.description: the root-owned zero-argument broker that drops into the capsule

runtime_root.description: the FROZEN ROOT-OWNED Resolve runtime. Never /opt/resolve: the operator can rewrite that one.

script_lib_relpath.description: the scripting extension, relative to runtime_root; production loads THIS file directly and never runs the vendor loader, whose fallback order ends in /opt/resolve

caller_identity.description: the account Hermes signs from, and the identity of the shared HMAC key. The key is owned by the operator and readable — never writable — by the capsule, so a compromised capsule cannot mint its own caller.

hmac_key_id.description: first 16 hex of sha256(key bytes); the worker recomputes it from the bytes it loaded

control_operations.description: the governed STOP. It is not a Resolve operation: it never attaches, takes no parameters and can name no process — it ends the ONE session the launcher attested. The accepted facade does not expose it.
